failure_layer_analysis.analysis: tower.local is an mDNS (multicast DNS, RFC 6762) link-local name. mDNS resolution is possible ONLY on the same L2 link (home Wi-Fi/LAN). On 4G cellular there is no multicast path: the name can never resolve. Even on the home Wi-Fi, Android's standard resolver (getaddrinfo/bionic, used by HttpURLConnection) does NOT resolve .local hostnames on the vast majority of Android builds, MIUI included — Android exposes NSD (NsdManager) for SERVICE discovery, not host-name resolution in the standard socket API.
failure_layer_analysis.verdict: UNRESOLVABLE on cellular (definitionally); UNRELIABLE-to-UNRESOLVABLE on Wi-Fi via the standard API
failure_layer_analysis.observed_symptom: UnknownHostException -> IOException -> typed NETWORK_UNREACHABLE -> 'Tower non raggiungibile'

failure_layer_analysis.analysis: Even if the name resolved (e.g., a build that resolves mDNS, or /etc/hosts-style pinning) and the TCP connection opened, https://tower.local requires a server certificate VALID FOR tower.local trusted by Android. The Tower's known public certificate is Let's Encrypt CN=hermestower.aclclouds.online (valid 2026-11-12 -> 2027-02-10, lane-verified) — it does NOT cover tower.local. A self-signed tower.local cert would be rejected as untrusted.
failure_layer_analysis.verdict: TLS WOULD FAIL (cert name mismatch / untrusted) — a SECOND stacked failure behind DNS

failure_layer_analysis.analysis: app network_security_config permits cleartext ONLY for loopback; an http:// variant of the endpoint would be blocked by Android policy at the cleartext check. The current endpoint is https, so NSC is not the active blocker — recorded for completeness (no bypass is permitted or proposed).
failure_layer_analysis.verdict: not active for https://tower.local; would block any http fallback

failure_layer_analysis.analysis: TowerApi collapses every IOException into NETWORK_UNREACHABLE with no DNS/TCP/TLS subclassification, so the Owner cannot distinguish 'name does not resolve on this network' from 'Tower down'.
